test_GPT2TokenizationTest: test the GPT2Tokenizer class with a custom vocab and merges file for BPE tokenization
test_tokenize_method: test the GPT2Tokenizer.tokenize method to split text into BPE subword tokens
test_convert_tokens_to_ids: test the GPT2Tokenizer.convert_tokens_to_ids method to map tokens to integer IDs
test_from_pretrained: test the GPT2Tokenizer.from_pretrained method to load a tokenizer from a directory
test_full_tokenizer: test the full GPT2Tokenizer pipeline including tokenization and ID conversion with unk_token
